text:
Riley Moore: Quick heads-up - product wants to flip unversioned keys to prefer v2 in a staged rollout. Need alignment on shadow sampling, quota projection, console preview, and fallback safety.
Tariq Hassan: +1 but we must keep per-route pins. /v1/embeddings and some rerank endpoints are wire-sensitive.
Zoe Park: Agreed. Plan: default behavior for new keys = prefer_v2; existing tenants unchanged until preview + opt-in. Provide a per-route `pin_v1` toggle.
Maya Ortiz: Telemetry first: we need shadow-run metrics and a way to detect semantic regressions (not just token delta).
telemetry-bot: Suggested metric set: redwood.migration.shadow.requests, redwood.migration.shadow.v1_count, redwood.migration.shadow.v2_count, redwood.migration.shadow.fallbacks, redwood.migration.shadow.token_delta_p50/p95, redwood.migration.semantic_regressions. Tag all with shadow_run_id and cohort.
Tariq Hassan: Quota concern: v2 tokenization and generation length differ. Add a `shadow_token_projection` field to quota-service so previews can show estimated monthly delta.
Riley Moore: Good. UX ask: migration preview card should show three numbers per-tenant per-route: est monthly token delta, est p95 latency delta, and % prompts flagged as risky. Include a small sample of diffed outputs.
Zoe Park: Also add an action: "Run shadow now" (ad-hoc) and "Schedule migration" (cohort-based). Per-route enable/disable in the same card.
Tariq Hassan: Shadow sampling defaults: sample_pct = 0.1 (per-route). Sample payload for kicking off a run: 
```
{
  "tenant_id": "t_acme",
  "routes": ["/v1/chat","/v1/embeddings"],
  "sample_pct": 0.1,
  "target": "v2-compat",
  "duration_hours": 24
}
```
Maya Ortiz: Header precedence: respect `x-api-version` and `x-client-version` first. Auto-switch applies only when request has no explicit version header and token isn't pinned. Emit `x-compat-mode: shadow` on responses so clients can detect.
deploy-bot: staging: migration-preview v0.3 deployed (build 2026-04-12-09).
Tariq Hassan: Fallback semantics: if tenant requests v1 but v1 is overloaded, we should surface a fallback code and only route to v2-compat when tenant allows `compat.auto_fallback=true`. Otherwise return 503 with a clear error.
Zoe Park: For enterprise customers allow `compat.exempt` flag that pins them to v1. Console action must include an audit log entry for changes.
Maya Ortiz: Circuit breaker proposal: if tenant_fallback_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR global_fallback_rate > 0.25% over 2m -> disable auto-switch for affected cohorts and trigger pager. Also emit telemetry event redwood.migration.circuit_trip.
Tariq Hassan: Add graceful throttle formula for immediate mitigation: throttle_pct = min(15, fallback_rate * 8). Bound to 15% to avoid hard stops.
telemetry-bot: We'll also add cohort tagging: migration_cohort:<id>, shadow_run_id. Historical v1 traffic will be cohort=0 for backfill.
Zoe Park: SDK note: document that v2 may include additional fields; SDKs should ignore unknown fields. Add changelog entry.
Riley Moore: Action items: 1) Tariq - route-manager + header precedence change + sample API (due Thu). 2) Maya - telemetry metric names + dashboard mock (due Wed). 3) Zoe - console preview mock + audit workflow (due Wed). 4) Eng-SRE - runbook and circuit thresholds (due Tue).
Tariq Hassan: I'll wire up the `compat_mode` enum (pinned_v1, pinned_v2, prefer_v2, shadow) and add the `shadow_token_projection` hook.
Maya Ortiz: We'll run an initial shadow against 1% of tenants in staging and then a 24h shadow on a 5% production cohort for validation.
Riley Moore: Nice. Let's reconvene after staging shadow numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Zoe Park: Thanks everyone :rocket:
